notes.title: RDPAC 1.1 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44707908/536cd9f3c76409b22c29967c5482a7ff06dc8326.png[/img]

Howdy, Cowpokes!

I’m thrilled to announce the latest update of Romanticized Dreams of a Post-Apocalyptic Cowpoke! With this new update comes some exciting new features and content along with some 
improvements to gameplay and UI.

Additionally I would like to congratulate KingAurorus! His wonderful soundtrack for Romanticized Dreams of a Post-Apocalyptic Cowpoke achieved bronze in the Global Music Awards.

[u]Gamepad Support and Cloud Saves[/u]
The first iteration of gamepad support is now available to try! Grab your favourite compatible controller and take on Baron Von Bandit! Play your saved game across any machine, profile data is now able to be synced to the steam cloud.

[u]Rusty Bean’s Cab Co.[/u]
Introducing a new arrival to The Town. Rusty Bean, proud owner of the Rusty Bean Cab Co. is here to help. This opens up a new way to spend any extra town tokens you have laying around, Rusty will take you to any completed level and offer a few starting items to help you out.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44707908/9d762ffadec9b555f0c494076e035978b5649c1d.png[/img]

[u]New Bosses[/u]
Two new bosses have been recruited to Baron Von Bandit’s gang of ruffians, Dandy, a suave frog with a lethal quickdraw has been stationed in the Forest. Along with Goldie who resides inside the dark goldmine using her brains and exo-suit to mine the earth of whatever gold hides below. These two new bosses come with their very own cosmetic unlocks and achievements for fighting them!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44707908/a568ae69284722807c1a3fb2d90f29eab0808c1c.png[/img]

[u]New Items, Weapons, and Apparel[/u]
All of the town merchants have recieved a few new items for their catelogues along with an additional few unlocks that can be obtained through achievements.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44707908/eef52db084206ce85fa863b6dc901534ec91c794.png[/img]

notes.title: RDPAC Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
[h2]Howdy Cowpokes![/h2]

I'm happy to announce the 1.0.2 update to the game which includes various bugfixes, balance changes, and some extra content. This new patch adds an additional 6 new weapons that are available from Mysty's Munitions along with a couple more items for Xiao's Emporium. A large amount of balance changes have been made to the scaling of weapons and the amount of bonus damage applied from items. The ice status effect has gotten a rework, it will no longer stun lock enemies as it was way too strong. Lastly some of the spawn rates have been changed on items along with the addition of a new consumable to collect. Hope all you Cowpokes enjoy the latest update and goodluck on your next run!

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[h3]New Weapons[/h3]
[list]
[*] Hunting Bow
[*] Compound Bow
[*] Dart Gun
[*] Spear Gun
[*] Axe Thrower
[*] Icicle Gun
[/list]
[h3]New Items[/h3]
[list]
[*] Smith Hammer
[*] Pocket Pal
[*] Honey Boots
[*] Hard Tack
[*] Six Pack
[/list]
[h3]Other Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ice Bullets have a cooldown on the freeze effect
[*] Frozen enemies create bullets upon being frozen again
[*] Rigpig should move around more
[*] Adjustments to boss armor scaling
[*] Basic Bow has been changed to Survival Bow
[*] Animation updates for crossbow + bows
[*] Charge sfx for bows
[*] Large amount of damage, scaling, and ammo tweaks for weapons
[*] Enemy hp adjustments
[*] Additional rooms
[*] New small ammo consumable
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Game viewport not being applied correctly
[*] Fixed Button input misalignment on game over and victory menus
[*] Fixed Villa gatling bandit running out of ammo
[*] Fixed Villa achievements not triggering
[*] Fixed bullets sprites scaling weird
[*] Fixed Pinwheel MK II sfx and death animations
[*] Fixed SMG drone incorrect icon
[*] Fixed Shotgun drone incorrect icon
[*] Fixed reward spawn points in some rooms
[*] Fixed safes not dropping passive items
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44707908/c500048afe25650625c9b2050d2aae7dacb44b0a.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 Achievements and Profile Stats
notes.content:
[h2]Howdy Cowpokes![/h2]

Update 1.0.1 is here with some new small features

[h3]Steam Achievements[/h3]

Show off your progress as the ultimate Cowpoke with Steam Achievements!

[h3]Profile Stats[/h3]

See you overall profile stats including: total victories, fastest victory along with a few other fun stats. It can be accessed through the Dream Journal on the pause menu. Your profile can be reset at anytime from the options on the main menu.

[h3]Other minor changes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Direction arrows for doors
[*] Removed reserve ammo count for infinite ammo weapons
[*] Some menu layout adjustments
[/list]

notes.title: Launch Announcement
notes.content:
[h2]Howdy Cowpokes![/h2]

I'm proud to announce the launch of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1487240/Romanticized_Dreams_of_a_PostApocalyptic_Cowpoke/]Romanticized Dreams of a Post-Apocalyptic Cowpoke[/url]! Fight your way through five bandit strongholds across the new frontier. Try and rid The Town of Baron Von Bandit's army of dastardly villians! It'll be a difficult and treacherous journey but there is no need to worry, afterall failure is just a bad dream. Spend tokens in the town to unlock new items and weapons to discover in future runs, or just buy some new clothes from Madame Silk to show off your style while fighting bandits. Each playthrough brings its own unique challenges and opportunities, with a variety of bosses, enemies, weapons and items no two playthroughs will ever be the same!

[h3]Soundtrack[/h3]
Additionally I'm excited to present the excellent handcrafted [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3000220/Romanticized_Dreams_of_a_PostApocalyptic_Cowpoke_Soundtrack/?beta=0]soundtrack[/url] for Romanticized Dreams of a Post-Apocalyptic Cowpoke is now available to purchase. So make sure to check that out if you'd like to show your support to the talented King Aurorus Music.

Find out more information about the creator of the amazing sounds of the Post-Apocalyptic West here:
[url=https://kingaurorusmusic.com/]https://kingaurorusmusic.com/[/url]

[h3]What's Next?[/h3]
Over the next few weeks here my priority will mainly be forcused on bugfixing and balacing. Afterwards there are plans in place for free additional content, enemies, weapons, and bosses.

[h3]A Personal Thank You[/h3]
I would also like to say as a solo developer everyone who takes a chance on a small indie studio has my deepest gratitude. I'm looking forward to seeing what the future holds for Romanticized Dreams of a Post-Apocalyptic Cowpoke. Goodluck out there Cowpokes!
